mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_live_recovery_audit (audit_id, case_id, actor_id, action, evidence_sha256, detail_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{caseId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{evidenceHash}, #{detailHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id, case_id, actor_id, action, evidence_sha256, detail_hash, created_at FROM quant_live_recovery_audit WHERE case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, audit_id ASC LIMIT 100
